label.zh: 殖民这颗星球后（非机械帝国）

texts.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]厚密的植被之下埋藏着人工构造。
texts.en: Sensors indicate there are artificial formations buried beneath rich vegetation on [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]厚密的植被之下埋藏着人工构造。
sections.en: Sensors indicate there are artificial formations buried beneath rich vegetation on [From.GetName].

texts.zh:
在对[From.GetName]上覆满植被的建筑进行调查之后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了它们与栖息在地表上的大量未开化真菌生物之间的可怕关联。

这些建筑似乎是由某种比我们更加先进的文明建造的，用来当作这些真菌生物的有机培养室。此外，这些真菌生物似乎被基因改造成一个用途：作为家畜来填饱其造物主的肚子。

这些生物被[Root.GetLeaderName]命名为[livestock_species.GetName]，是一种思考能力贫乏的温顺生物，这很可能也是其造物主的设计。只需要土壤养分与热量即可存活并繁殖，未来的殖民者们或许可以将它们派上一些用场。
texts.en:
Following investigation of the grown-over structures on [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has uncovered a grisly connection between them and the vast population of pre-sapient fungoids living on its surface.

It would appear a civilization more technologically advanced than even our own constructed these structures as organic growing chambers for the fungoids. What is more, the fungoids seem to have been genetically tailored and defined to serve one purpose: filling the stomachs of their creator species, as livestock.

The creatures, termed [livestock_species.GetName] by [Root.GetLeaderName], are a docile species largely incapable of complex problem-solving, likely by their creator's design. Requiring only soil nutrition and warmth to survive and procreate, they could potentially be of some use to any future colonists.

label.zh: 珍贵的有机生物。它们应该得到细心的照顾。
label.en: Precious organics. They deserve the best pampering.

label.zh: 同化价值：低于最佳标准。
它们必须被消灭。迟早有一天。
label.en: They shall be exterminated. All in good time.

label.zh: 如果不采点儿样品不就太不礼貌了吗。
label.en: It would be rude not to have a sample.

label.zh: 殖民这颗星球后（非机械帝国）

texts.zh:
既然我们已经在[From.GetName]上殖民，我们得决定该如何处置那些栖息在地表上的未开化真菌生物。

通常情况下，我们关于未开化生物的政策足以在新的殖民地上应对它们。不过，[livestock_species.GetName]看起来确实非常美味。因其非常温顺的天性，将[livestock_species.GetName]们聚集起来赶进处理中心应该不是难事……
texts.en:
Now that we have colonized [From.GetName], we should decide what is to be done with the pre-sapient fungoids living on its surface.

In normal circumstances, our policies regarding pre-sapients would be sufficient in dealing with their presence on our new colony. However, the [livestock_species.GetName]s do look particularly delicious. Due to their incredibly docile nature, it should be relatively easy to round the [livestock_species.GetName]s up into a processing center...

label.zh: 确实诱人。但我们将遵守我们的规定。
label.en: Tempting. But we will adhere to our policies.

tooltips.en: Round up the [livestock_species.GetName] populations on [From.GetName] into planetside processor pens. (Produces: £food£ 14)

summary.text:
# 杂草丛生的遗迹 / Overgrown Ruins

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:864-898; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9799 (distar.260); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9832 (distar.261); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9980 (distar.262); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1307

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。热带、大陆、草原、高山、海洋或盖亚星球可能生成（6级，权重1；被前超光速文明占有的星球为0）。生成时隐藏事件 distar.260 立即在星球上放置城市废墟矿藏、创建前智慧真菌类“家畜”物种（5个人口组）并标记 funlent_planet。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on tropical, continental, savannah, alpine, ocean or Gaia planets (level 6, weight 1; 0 if owned by a primitive civilisation). On spawn the hidden distar.260 adds city ruins, creates a pre-sapient fungoid "livestock" species (5 pop groups) and flags the planet funlent_planet.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.261“野生真核生物”：被植被掩盖的建筑是比我们更先进的文明为真菌类生物建造的培养室，这些温顺的生物被基因定制为造主的食物。各选项都给予社会学研究。
2. 若之后殖民这颗星球（非机械帝国），on_colonized 触发 distar.262“美味的真核生物”：按既有前智慧政策处理（获得影响力），或支付300能量把它们圈进加工栏（获得加工栏矿藏，所有家畜人口被消灭）。

1. distar.261 "Wild Eukaryotes": the overgrown structures were growing chambers built by a civilisation more advanced than ours for the fungoids, which were engineered to be its livestock. Every option rewards society research.
2. If the planet is later colonised by a non-machine empire, on_colonized fires distar.262 "Delicious Eukaryotes": keep to the pre-sapient policies (influence) or pay 300 energy to pen them (processing pens deposit; all livestock pops are killed).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.261 只有一个结果；distar.262 的两个选项互斥（b 需300能量）。

distar.261 has one result; distar.262's two options are exclusive (b needs 300 energy).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.261 的选项文本随文明变化：排外/令人不安（默认）、狂热威权或奴隶公会、吞噬虫群、仆从、同化者、终结者、狂热净化者、演化猎手（获得DNA与局势进度）。

distar.261's option wording varies: default "Disturbing", fanatic authoritarian or Slaver Guilds, Devouring Swarm, Servitor, Assimilator, Terminator, Fanatic Purifier, Evolutionary Predators (DNA and situation progress).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义（含 on_spawn distar.260）、distar.261、distar.262 与 on_colonized。修正：distar.262 在草稿中是独立故事；现以审阅连接接在异常结果之后。distar.262 不要求先调查异常（标记在生成时设置）。

Checked the anomaly (incl. on_spawn distar.260), distar.261, distar.262 and on_colonized. Correction: distar.262 was a separate story; it now follows the anomaly result through a reviewed link. It does not require the anomaly to be researched (the flag is set on spawn).
